description: A thickly brushed oil painting at night: a tall tapering furnace or kiln with a glowing white-orange molten core and flame at its top, sparks flying left, and what looks like a bellows in the lower left foreground. The setting is a dark navy night sky and dark ground. There are no people, no letters or numbers, no frame or border, and nothing gory. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner.
reason: Shows a furnace or forge with a bellows and flying sparks, but the card is Parisian salon culture (elite women hosting Enlightenment conversation in 1715). There is no salon, drawing room, people or conversation; repaint it as a candlelit Parisian salon with gathered figures.
